subject.title: fix #95351: [Feature]: Generic JSONL line-parsing hook for CliBackendPlugin (native tool-card support beyond claude-stream-json)

question: Should OpenClaw make `CliBackendPlugin.parseJsonlEvent` and its normalized event union a supported public plugin SDK contract for arbitrary JSONL CLI backends?
rationale: The patch is an opt-in extension at the intended plugin boundary, but accepting the permanent API shape and support commitment is a maintainer product and SDK decision rather than a mechanical correctness choice.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow SDK contract
options.body: Approve the opt-in parser hook after its exact event semantics and compatibility promise are reviewed, then require current-main and live-CLI proof before merge.

options.title: Defer until a concrete plugin ships
options.body: Keep the feature request open and revisit the API once an external plugin demonstrates that the existing seams cannot meet its needs.

options.title: Reject the public hook direction
options.body: Close this implementation path and retain built-in JSONL dialect handling unless a different generic plugin contract is designed.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow SDK contract
recommendation.body: Approve the opt-in parser hook after its exact event semantics and compatibility promise are reviewed, then require current-main and live-CLI proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: A public plugin SDK admission decision needs repository-level API ownership; no more-specific current-main history owner was available in the supplied review data.
